column1: # Every foreground/background pairing the system ships.
# Name TOKENS, never copy their values: a copied hex keeps passing after the
# token changes. A row naming tokens is resolved against tokens.css on every
# run, in both themes unless the fifth column says light or dark. A literal
# colour that matches no token fails as a stale copy.
#   ui     = 3.0:1 interactive component boundaries and focus indicators
#          python3 scripts/brandcheck.py render style-tile.html   (what the page actually paints)
# Ratios are truncated, never rounded up — 4.499:1 does not meet 4.5:1.
# Every surface an element can sit on needs its own row: a border that passes
# on the page ground can fail on a sunken well. Adjacent colour is what counts.
